verificationSummary: Editor commit 940b4dfc5f61fa551993c9c853c5c8aed0a986c5 adds bounded canvas text-descendant selection so a click on text represented inside a columns/table paper preview can select the exact editable text-block descendant and visibly highlight the matching Structure/Outline item. PaperBlock now marks composite preview text cells with data-canvas-text-descendant-id derived from editableTextDescendants, while leaving descendant text blocks out of the renderable surface order and retaining the owning surface data-node-id for structural behavior. PaperPageStack checks hitTestCanvasTextDescendantTarget before ordinary canvas hit testing on click, calls selection through source canvas-text-descendant, and keeps pointer drag/reorder surface-based by avoiding parent-first selection flicker when the pointer starts on a descendant marker. editorView resolveEditorSelectionTargetForSource preserves exact editable text-block ids for outline and canvas-text-descendant sources, while ordinary canvas still resolves internal nodes through their owning operation surface. Backend mutation safety remains guarded: EditorMutationCommandSource excludes canvas-text-descendant, add-node contract sources are mutation-safe, and backendMutationRequests rejects accidental canvas-text-descendant mutation request building with the reason Canvas text descendant selection cannot build a backend mutation request. RED evidence included npm run test -- --run src/tests/selectionHitTest.test.ts src/tests/commands.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts failing because hitTestCanvasTextDescendantTarget was missing, canvas-text-descendant selection still normalized summary-left-text to summary-columns, and PaperBlock did not render data-canvas-text-descendant-id. GREEN evidence passed npm run test -- --run src/tests/selectionHitTest.test.ts src/tests/commands.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts with 24 tests, npm run type-check, npm run test -- --run src/tests/selectionHitTest.test.ts src/tests/commands.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/backendIntegration.test.ts src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts with 43 tests after fixture update, and npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke in the Editor worktree. npm run check in the sibling Editor worktree passed type-check, 102 Vitest files with 362 tests, and build, with only the retained Vite chunk-size warning. Merged Editor main passed npm run check and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke with final Outline order editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > summary-left-text > summary-right-text > detail-table > detail-cell-a-text > detail-cell-b-text. The retained smoke records selectionMethod canvas-text-descendant-preview, previewHitTargetPresent true, selectedOutlineNodeIds summary-left-text, and reloadedSelectedOutlineNodeIds summary-left-text before continuing the live Backend reorder proof. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct click-to-type authoring from the preview child, exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, arbitrary rich-inline authoring beyond existing bounded textarea lanes, field-ref chip editing, generic table/toc/page-break add paths, document v4 insert semantics, durable draft persistence, collaboration, large-document performance readiness, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, export parity, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor npm install still reports 5 high severity audit findings and Vite retains the existing chunk-size warning.
